# SVG asset attribution

## Bravura music notation glyphs

- Source: [Steinberg Bravura](https://github.com/steinbergmedia/bravura)
- Copyright: Steinberg Media Technologies GmbH
- License: [SIL Open Font License 1.1](https://github.com/steinbergmedia/bravura/blob/master/LICENSE.txt)
- Files used: five-line staff, leger line, final barline, G clef, time-signature digit 4, quarter notes, and sharp accidental.
- Modification: the selected glyph outlines were mechanically exported from the official Bravura font into individual SVG documents and assigned the site's single accent colour. The notation shapes were not redrawn.

## OpenMoji violin line art

- Source: [OpenMoji violin U+1F3BB](https://github.com/hfg-gmuend/openmoji/blob/master/black/svg/1F3BB.svg)
- Creator: OpenMoji
- License: [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
- Local file: `openmoji/violin-line.svg`
- Modification: the source SVG is stored unchanged. The site applies only CSS sizing, opacity, and colour filtering.
